fresh_task_selection_protocol.recommended_task_unit: An independently authored upstream regression test delta applied to its frozen pre-fix parent, with the author production patch withheld. This is a real native obligation, not an injected synthetic defect.
fresh_task_selection_protocol.selection: Before source/outcome reads, freeze a deterministic metadata-only sample from a declared finite universe of independent repositories and revision pairs. Record all exclusions from existing inventory, prior source archives/checkouts and prior exposed target identities. Fetch exact commits only after implementation/protocol freeze.
fresh_task_selection_protocol.metadata_rule_example: Freeze eligible public Python repository IDs and bug/regression-labelled merged revision IDs using only API metadata. Select fixed N sorted by SHA256(protocol seed, repository, revision). Freeze base/head IDs, test/config authority and every intended future before diff/test inspection. Do not use result-dependent substitution.
fresh_task_selection_protocol.minimum_tasks: If retaining original V104 support>=2 sources, supply at least two acquisition tasks and two protected future tasks. Prefer distinct repositories for future source-distinct transfer; otherwise disclose same-project scope.
fresh_task_selection_protocol.independent_contract: Generic overlay rule installs only independently authored test delta into base snapshot. Freeze exact rules for additions/renames/config and reject ambiguous non-test authority or setup-dependent changes. A separate verifier can establish author-head validity, but developer sees no production patch or protected outcome before selection.
fresh_task_selection_protocol.collection_guards: Nonzero executed cases, original tests immutable, candidate production paths only, errors/skips/timeout UNKNOWN, correct implementation actually imported. Include every selected setup failure or already-satisfied case; do not replace until a predetermined next protocol.
fresh_task_selection_protocol.source_independence_boundary: Untouched means no source/tests/outcomes inspected by this experiment before freeze; model pretraining familiarity cannot be excluded.
